name: DCC MCP Framework
description: Mother-repo framework for building MCP servers for Digital Content Creation tools. Provides reusable templates and 4 Claude skills for scaffolding, extending, and auditing DCC MCP servers.
author: kleer001

skills.name: Scaffold DCC MCP
skills.description: Create a new DCC MCP server repository from framework templates. Use whenever the user wants to bootstrap a new MCP server for a DCC tool (Maya, Cinema4D, Krita, Resolve, etc.).

skills.name: Add Tool Domain
skills.description: Add a new tool domain (lighting, rendering, tracking, etc.) to an existing DCC MCP server.

skills.name: Add Advanced Feature
skills.description: Add an opt-in advanced capability to a DCC MCP server: bidirectional events, offline RAG, persistent memory, headless auto-launch, version gating, plugin discovery, undo integration, or recipes.

skills.name: Audit DCC MCP
skills.description: Audit and improve an existing DCC MCP server against the framework blueprint for protocol conformance, thread-safety, mock parity, and best practices.
